app.name: WC04 Camera (experimental)
app.long_description: Camera app for the Ubisoft / Hercules WC04 (057e:030a). Requires IOS58; writable SD is needed to save photos. A opens the live viewfinder, then A takes a photo. B returns to the menu. In the menu, A/B opens the viewfinder, 1 changes resolution and 2 checks the camera connection. HOME exits. Includes a new color renderer and automatic saved-photo review. Capture at both resolutions and Photo Channel playback were confirmed in 0.1.3; the new viewfinder and display changes still need hardware testing. If stopping waits for USB, unplug the camera.
